name: floating-prompt-marketplace
description: Single-plugin marketplace for floating-prompt, a Windows-native floating popup that blocks Claude Code hooks (Stop, AskUserQuestion, ExitPlanMode, Notification, PermissionRequest) until the user answers or dismisses with double-Esc.

plugins.name: floating-prompt
plugins.description: Blocks each Claude Code turn behind a topmost, no-activate floating window; answer to continue, double-Esc to dismiss.
